messages:
maria: quick sync  updating the HelloApp quickstart to make token auth explicit and streamline the first deploy. opening PRs for docs + example + sdk snippets. draft quickstart: https://github.com/redwood/quickstart/pull/492 (WIP)

devon: i can do the SDK snippet. do we want to standardize on REDWOOD_KEY rather than REDWOOD_API_KEY?

maria: yes prefer REDWOOD_KEY but keep fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY for backwards compat. tiny migration blurb will be included.

lila: i'll update the .env.sample and the README in the example repo. also found one anchor mismatch in the deploy guide that breaks when we render the docs site; will fix that path.

sachin: add a short security note: blur tokens in screenshots, and recommend minimal scopes (generate/read). i'll draft wording for the token scope sentence.

maria: suggested JS snippet (keep it minimal):
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/ft-1', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(resp.text);
```

devon: nice. i'll add the curl example too. compact curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood/ft-1","prompt":"Hi"}'
```

lila: pushed .env.sample changes and replaced the broken anchor. adding a blurred Console screenshot (1200px width, <200kb).

tom: small infra note  some infra templates still expect REDWOOD_API_KEY env var. i'll open a cleanup PR to swap or add comments about the fallback.

docs-bot: preview deployed  https://deploy-preview-492--docs.redwood.ai (quickstart) and https://deploy-preview-214--sdk.redwood.ai (snippets) :white_check_mark:

devon: added a tiny jest mock in sdk/examples asserting the Authorization header is set when REDWOOD_KEY is present. also changed snippet to named import `RedwoodClient`.

sachin: reviewed wording. tiny nit: add one sentence under Quickstart: "If you previously used REDWOOD_API_KEY your setup will continue to work; we recommend using REDWOOD_KEY going forward." and note rotation best practices for org docs.

maria: added a CHANGELOG entry under docs: "quickstart: prefer REDWOOD_KEY in examples; preserve REDWOOD_API_KEY fallback". also opened follow-up to add CLI token creation commands.

lila: assigned reviewers @devon and @sachin. merging once previews are both green.

devon: approved SDK PR; will merge after quickstart preview check. :eyes:

docs-bot: quickstart preview passed visual diffs.

maria: merged both PRs. will follow up with a plain-language Console token helper and a short enterprise note about KMS/rotation.

sachin: happy to draft the rotation/KMS paragraph for enterprise docs.

maria: thanks everyone. closing this sync  ping if anything breaks. :tada:
